title: A Noetherian scheme receiving a finite surjective morphism from an affine scheme is affine
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Assume that (1) $f$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], (2) $f$ is surjective, i.e. $|Y|\to|X|$ is surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], (3) $Y$ is an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], and (4) $X$ is Noetherian, i.e. locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Then $X$ is an affine scheme.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (label lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian, coherent.tex line 3557), with its proof (H^1(X,F)=0 for every coherent F by the devissage Lemma lemma-property-higher-rank-cohomological, using Lemma lemma-finite-morphism-Noetherian, lemma-affine-morphism-projection-ideal, lemma-quasi-coherent-affine-cohomology-zero and lemma-relative-affine-cohomology; then X affine by Serre's criterion, Lemma 01XF lemma-quasi-compact-h1-zero-covering or lemma-quasi-separated-h1-zero-covering)

proof.text: (Preliminaries.) $f$ is finite, so it is affine [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and locally of finite type [lem-weil-pbc-finite-iff-integral-lft]; as $X$ is locally Noetherian, so is $Y$ [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft]. On the locally Noetherian schemes $X$ and $Y$ a module is coherent iff it is quasi-coherent of finite type [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth]; in particular every coherent $\mathcal O_X$- or $\mathcal O_Y$-module is quasi-coherent.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian, coherent.tex line 3557), proof; Stacks uses 'a finite morphism is affine' and the coherence/quasi-coherence of the sheaves without comment (the local Noetherianity of Y is in the proof of 01YO)

proof.text: (The property; hypothesis (1).) For a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ let $\mathcal P(\mathcal F)$ mean $H^1(X,\mathcal F)=0$, cohomology as in [pqf-def-cohomology]. We verify hypotheses (0), (1), (2), (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-property-devissage-integral-subschemes] for $\mathcal P$. (0): $H^1(X,0)=0$, since the zero module has the zero injective resolution [pqf-def-cohomology]. (1): a short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal F_1\to\mathcal F\to\mathcal F_2\to0$ of coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules gives the long exact cohomology sequence [pqf-def-cohomology], whose part $H^1(X,\mathcal F_1)\to H^1(X,\mathcal F)\to H^1(X,\mathcal F_2)$ is exact; if the outer terms are $0$, so is $H^1(X,\mathcal F)$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian, coherent.tex line 3557), proof, second paragraph ('Property (1) follows from the long exact cohomology sequence')

proof.text: (Hypothesis (2).) Let $\mathcal F$ be coherent with $H^1(X,\mathcal F^{\oplus r})=0$, $r\ge1$. The inclusion $\iota:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^{\oplus r}$ of the first summand and the projection $\pi:\mathcal F^{\oplus r}\to\mathcal F$ onto it satisfy $\pi\circ\iota=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal F}$. Since $H^1(X,-)$ is a functor [pqf-def-cohomology], $H^1(\pi)\circ H^1(\iota)=\mathrm{id}_{H^1(X,\mathcal F)}$, so the identity of $H^1(X,\mathcal F)$ factors through $H^1(X,\mathcal F^{\oplus r})=0$, and $H^1(X,\mathcal F)=0$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian, coherent.tex line 3557), proof, second paragraph ('Property (2) follows since H^1(X,-) is an additive functor'; written here with a retraction, which needs only functoriality)

proof.text: (Hypothesis (3), the sheaf $\mathcal G$, (a) and (b).) Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion with $Z$ integral and $\xi\in X$ with $\overline{\{\xi\}}=i(Z)$. As $f$ is finite and surjective and $X$ is locally Noetherian, [lem-weil-pbc-finite-surjective-coherent-generic-support] gives a coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module $\mathcal F$ with $\operatorname{Supp}(f_*\mathcal F)=i(Z)$ and $\mathfrak m_\xi(f_*\mathcal F)_\xi=0$. Put $\mathcal G=f_*\mathcal F$; it is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [lem-weil-pbc-finite-pushforward-coherent] ($f$ finite, $X$ locally Noetherian), and it satisfies (a) and (b) of [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-property-devissage-integral-subschemes](3).

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian, coherent.tex line 3557), proof, third paragraph (Stacks does not say that G = f_*F is coherent, which the devissage lemma requires; it is Lemma 01Y6)

proof.text: (Hypothesis (3)(c): the subsheaf $\mathcal G'$.) Let $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals with $\mathcal J_\xi=\mathcal O_{X,\xi}$, and put $\mathcal G'=\mathcal J\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal G$, the image of $\mathcal J\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G\to\mathcal G$. Since $\mathcal G$ is quasi-coherent (step 1), $\mathcal G'$ is a quasi-coherent sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module of $\mathcal G$ [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-times-quasi-coherent-affine-sections](1), hence coherent, being a quasi-coherent submodule of the coherent $\mathcal G$ on the locally Noetherian $X$ [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-kernel-cokernel-locnoeth](2). Its stalk is $\mathcal G'_\xi=\mathcal J_\xi\mathcal G_\xi=\mathcal O_{X,\xi}\mathcal G_\xi=\mathcal G_\xi$ as submodules of $\mathcal G_\xi$ [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk](1),(2). It remains to show $\mathcal P(\mathcal G')$, i.e. $H^1(X,\mathcal G')=0$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian, coherent.tex line 3557), proof, third paragraph ('the quasi-coherent subsheaf G' = JG satisfies P'; Stacks does not write out the coherence of G' or the equality of stalks G'_xi = G_xi)

proof.text: (Hypothesis (3)(c): $H^1(X,\mathcal G')=0$.) $f$ is affine (step 1) and $\mathcal F$ is quasi-coherent (step 1), so by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-pushforward-ideal-product] the sheaf $\mathcal F'=f^{-1}\mathcal J\cdot\mathcal F$ is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module and $\mathcal G'=\mathcal J\cdot f_*\mathcal F=f_*\mathcal F'$. Since $f$ is affine and $\mathcal F'$ quasi-coherent, the edge map $H^1(X,f_*\mathcal F')\to H^1(Y,\mathcal F')$ is an isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-cohomology-edge]. Since $Y$ is affine, $Y$ is an affine open of itself and $H^1(Y,\mathcal F')=0$ [pqf-lem-affine-vanishing]. Hence $H^1(X,\mathcal G')=H^1(X,f_*\mathcal F')\cong H^1(Y,\mathcal F')=0$, and $\mathcal G'$ satisfies (3)(c) of [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-property-devissage-integral-subschemes].

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian, coherent.tex line 3557), proof, third paragraph (Lemmas 01YP, 01XB and 089W)

proof.text: (All coherent sheaves.) $X$ is Noetherian and $\mathcal P$ satisfies (0), (1), (2), (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-property-devissage-integral-subschemes] (steps 2 to 6), so $H^1(X,\mathcal F)=0$ for every coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YQ (lemma-image-affine-finite-morphism-affine-Noetherian, coherent.tex line 3557), proof, first two paragraphs

proof.text: (Serre's criterion.) $X$ is quasi-compact (hypothesis (4)) and quasi-separated, being locally Noetherian [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated]. Let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of finite type. On the locally Noetherian $X$ it is coherent [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth], so $H^1(X,\mathcal I)=0$ by step 7. By Serre's criterion [pqf-lem-serre-criterion] $X$ is affine.

split_report.summary: Split following Stacks 01YQ and its proof (coherent.tex 3557-3616) in 8 steps: preliminaries (f affine and of finite type, Y locally Noetherian, coherent = quasi-coherent of finite type), the devissage hypotheses (1) by the long exact sequence, (2) by a retraction (functoriality only), (3)(a)(b) from 01YO with G = f_*F coherent by 01Y6, (3)(c) with G' = JG coherent, G'_xi = G_xi, and H^1(X, JG) = H^1(X, f_*(f^{-1}J F)) = H^1(Y, f^{-1}J F) = 0 by 01YP, 089W, 01XB; then the devissage lemma 01YM gives H^1(X,F) = 0 for all coherent F and Serre's criterion 01XG (quasi-separated by 01OY, finite-type ideals coherent by 01XZ) gives X affine. Three new unsplit nodes: the devissage lemma 01YM, Lemma 01YO, Lemma 01YP with the quasi-coherence of f^{-1}I F that 01YQ takes from the proof of 01YP. Tags checked in tags/tags: 01YM (not 01YI), 01YO (not 01YL), 01YP, 01XB, 089W (lemma-relative-affine-cohomology; 01XC is the vanishing of R^p f_*), 01XG. Mathlib: no cohomology of O_X-modules, no coherent sheaves, no affineness criterion of Chevalley or Serre; searches recorded.
